visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Last Letter Stays Behind
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Reversing "hello" should print olleh, but the program prints lleho.

solution.explanation: In the swap, n - 1 - i is meant to be the mirror index, which only works when n is the length. With n already reduced by one, every mirror index is one too small and the last character is never moved.
